rows.abstract: Starting 1996, all public schoolteachers shall receive a mid-year bonus equivalent to one (1) month gross compensation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE "NATIONAL ORGANIC FARMING DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL," PRESCRIBING ITS POWERS AND DUTIES, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The proposed NATIONAL ORGANIC FARMING DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL (NOFDC), to be organized sixty (60) days after effectivity of this Act, is tasked to promote organic farming throughout the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE SECOND WORLD WAR VETERANS OFFICE, PRESCRIBING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The PHILIPPINE SECOND WORLD WAR VETERANS OFFICE (PSWWVO) shall prepare, integrate, coordinate, supervise and control all plans, programs, projects of the government relative to the affairs of Filipino WW II veterans.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL MANPOWER DATA AND PLACEMENT CENTER, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The NATIONAL MANPOWER DATA AND PLACEMENT CENTER under the Dept. of Labor and Employment (DOLE) shall serve as the national manpower skills data bank and placement agency for local employment. It shall likewise serve as counterpart of the POEA.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT AWARDING TO VICTIMS OF CRIMES DEPICTED IN A MOVIE, BOOK, NEWSPAPER, MAGAZINE, RADIO OR TELEVISION PRODUCTION, OR LIVE ENTERTAINMENT, OF ANY KIND, OR ANY OTHER FORM OF COMMERCIAL EXHIBITION, PART OF THE PROCEEDS DUE TO THE CRIMINAL WHOSE STORYOF THE COMMISSION OF A CRIME OR CRIMES IS DEPICTED IN SAID EXHIBITION
rows.abstract: Seventy percent (70%) of the proceeds from any contract relating to the depiction of a crime in a movie, book, radio, TV, etc. shall be awarded and released to the VICTIM of the crime, his or her heirs or successors in interest. The rest shall be awarded to the immediate family of the criminal portrayed in the depiction.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE SMALL RUMINANT CENTER, DEFINING ITS SCOPE AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Substantiates the policy of the State to conserve, improve and develop the Philippine goat/sheep raising industry.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING RAPE VICTIMS ASSISTANCE CENTERS IN EACH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT, AND CREATING RAPE CRISIS DESKS IN EVERY POLICE PRECINCT, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The Rape Victims Assistance Center shall primarily provide assistance to victims of rape.  It shall monitor rape cases, provide legal and psychological assistance to the victims, and facilitate processing of financial assistance.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A009
rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING THE EQUITY OF THE INCUMBENT RULE IN THE APPRECIATION OF BALLOTS FOR NATIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTIONS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Gives equal opportunity to all candidates bearing the same name or sruname which is also in line with the cosntitutional mandate for the State to guarantee equal access to opportunities for public service.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 1998-09-29

rows.author: C061
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING EACH CITY AND MUNICIPALITY TO CREATE A RIVER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY FOR THE PRESERVATION, PROTECTION, AND DEVELOPMENT OF ALL RIVERS, RIVER SYSTEMS, AND NATURAL WATERWAYS WITHIN ITS RESPECTIVE JURISDICTION, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The author explains that a great number of our rivers, 421 principal rivers and 384 river systems, are gradully vanishing, many are dying and the rest are suffering from physical damages.  An efficient institutional machinery to implement our laws on the preservation and development of rivers must be created.
rows.status: Business for the day on 2000-03-21

rows.author: B012
rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOWING BAR FLUNKERS TO RETAKE ONLY THE SUBJECTS WHICH THEY FAILED IN THE BAR EXAMS
rows.abstract: The conditions of the proposal are (1) That the general average obtained in the Bar is not more than two (2) percent below the passing average; and (2) that there should be no grade below 50% in any sibject.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-09-29

rows.author: A037
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7610, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "SPECIAL PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AGAINST CHILD ABUSE, EXPLOITATION AND DISCRIMINATION ACT", SO AS TO PROVIDE A SPECIFIC SECTION FOR STREET CHILDREN, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Defines "STREET CHILDREN" as used in this Act.  Contains provisions on MEASURES TO PROTECT RIGHTS and TO PROMOTE WELFARE of children.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SOCIAL SERVICES since 1998-09-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 61, 62, 63 AND 65 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975 PLACING FOR THE PURPOSE THE PROVINCIAL JAILS UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF THE BUREAU OF JAIL MANAGEMENT AND PENOLOGY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Proposes to take away the supervision and control over provincial and sub-provincial jails from the provincial governments, and place this under the Bureau of Jail Management and Penalogy. Creates the position of PROVINCIAL JAIL ADMINISTRATOR to supervise all local jails in the province.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10747

rows.author: C012
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO AMEND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6425, KNOWN AS THE DANGEROUS DRUG ACT OF 1972, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7659, BY ELIMINATING THE QUANTITY OF THE DANGEROUS DRUGS INVOLVED AS BASIS FOR IMPOSING THE PENALTY FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: Rationale: The amendments introduced to RA 7659, the Dangerous Drugs Act, were inutile in solving the problem. Instead of increasing the penalty for violations, in reality the penalty was decreased.  As a result, big time pushers and traffickers when arrested usually invoked their right to bail.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06047

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPRESSLY RECOGNIZING THE CANON LAWS OF THE ROMAN CATHOLIC CHURCH, AS WELL AS THE LAWS OF OTHER CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATIONS OR DENOMINATIONS
rows.abstract: As stated, a marriage declared to be NULL AND VOID by the Roman Catholic Church or its matrimonial tribunal, and/or any duly authorized officer of any other Christian religious organization or denomination, including the Moslem religion, shall be considered NULL AND VOID by the State.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-09-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING TAX AMNESTY ON UNTAXED INCOME AND/OR WEALTH EARNED OR ACQUIRED PRIOR TO DECEMBER 31, 1997 AND AS A CONDITION PRECEDENT THEREOF REQUIRING THE FILING OF THE STATEMENT OF ASSETS, LIABILITIES AND NET WORTH AS OF DECEMBER 31, 1997
rows.abstract: The author considers it more practical to affor errant taxpayers the opportunity to reform by requiring them to make a truthful disclosure of their untaxed assets. This proposal is also one way of raising much needed revenues for the government.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05346

rows.title_full: AN ACT ORGANIZING A BARANGAY-ENERGI ZED ASSOCIATION IN EVERY BARANGAY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The proposed Barangay-Energi zed Association shall render services with compensation to the franchise holder of electric companies by (1) supplying wooden electric posts; (2) negotiating the acquisition of rights-of-way; and (3) protecting electricwires and cables from being vandalized.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1998-09-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING LOCAL SANGGUNIANG MEMBERS TO UNDERGO TRAINING ON HEALTH CARE SERVICES IN EMERGENCY CASES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Rationale:  A Sangguniang member properly informed and oriented with health care services will be able to give emergency care and can impart this knowledge and training to the local residents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-09-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 1691 OF THE CIVIL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES AND ARTICLE 147 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES AS AMENDED(RE: OPPORTUNITY FOR EDUCATION OF HOUSEHELPERS WHO ARE UNDER 18 YEARS OLD)
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to grant househelpers the opportunity for education. This refers to househelpers under eighteen (18) years of age.
